sentences.text: Blapl No.7674 of 2023
Jnanendra Nayak .... Petitioner

Mr. A.R. Panda, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha .... Opp. Party
 Mr. S.S. Mohapatra, Asc
 Coram:
 Justice M.S. Sahoo
 Order
19.10.2023 Order No. Hybrid Mode 05. 1.

The BLAPL has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. seeking release on bail, by the petitioner,
who is in jail custody in connection with Jharsuguda Sadar P.S. Case No.151 of 2023 corresponding to C.T. Case No.981 of 2023 pending in the court of learned S.D.J.M., Jharsuguda, for alleged commission of offence under Sections 420/468/419/406/409/34 of IPC.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner reiterates his submissions as noted earlier that the petitioner has not misappropriated any money as alleged.
The Final Prosecution Report has been submitted on 27.09.2023 wherein it is indicated that the informant did not produce anything to indicate that the petitioner has received any money.
The copy of the Final Prosecution Report has been served on the learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State.
The Learned Additional Standing // 2 // Counsel has also obtained up-to-date case diary which is in sync with the submissions of the learned counsel for the petitioner.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner being a local person, there is no possibility of he not submitting to the jurisdiction of the learned court in seisin of the matter and the petitioner shall abide by all the terms and conditions that would be imposed.

sentences.text: 4. Learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail of the petitioner referring to the materials contained in the case diary submitted by the investigating agency.

5. Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State, considering the material contained in the case diary as well as the up-to-date instruction furnished by the investigating agency, this Court is inclined to grant bail to the petitioner subject to such stringent terms and conditions that would be imposed by the learned court in seisin of the matter, which shall also include a condition that any violation of deviation from any of the terms and conditions that would be imposed, shall result in filing of the petition for cancellation of bail by the law enforcement agency.
6. The BLAPL is disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy as per rules.
Signed by: JYOSTNARANI MAJHEE (M.S. Sahoo)
